label: Sorrel Dane's first greeting — whose garden paid

purpose.value: Sorrel treats the hero's scrapes gently and mentions — too softly to land — that half her pharmacopoeia was bred by the fen folk he marched through calling corruption.

emotionalProgression.note: Poultice, patience, and the meadow manner; you don't pull a plant up to check the roots.
The salve is fen-grown mallow, bred gentler over two hundred years — she offers the provenance with the medicine.
He thanks her sincerely, files her under 'harmless', and leaves; the worry stays behind in the garden rows.

notes: Ambient worry, herbalist register: her flaw is load-bearing — she is so gentle the hero hears nothing she says. The Drowned Fen commons fact is hintable through plant provenance, not stated as geopolitics. She only suspects the book's genre — no book reference. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
